vaccination.title: The camp is not the last mile
vaccination.opening: A date on a notice is not a visit completed. Between the two sit an explanation, a record, and a journey someone has to make.
vaccination.segment: Work on getting families to an existing service. You are not diagnosing or prescribing.
vaccination.limit: Reaching a camp is not a measured change in district vaccination coverage.

antenatal_visits.title: A morning away from work
antenatal_visits.opening: The appointment takes a line in the register. Making it can take a morning: finding the record, understanding the instructions, getting to the clinic.
antenatal_visits.segment: Work on routine visit coordination. Medical decisions remain with qualified staff.
antenatal_visits.limit: An attended visit is not a measured health outcome or a district coverage forecast.

sanitation.title: A ticket does not repair a toilet
sanitation.opening: The complaint has a number now. At the other end of it, a repair still needs a person, materials, and enough hours in the day.
sanitation.segment: Work on the repair-request segment. New construction and water supply are outside this small intervention.
sanitation.limit: A repair visit is not proof that a household has gained improved sanitation.

birth_registration.title: The name in the register
birth_registration.opening: There is a child, a name, and a bundle of papers. The task is to get the family through an existing process without another wasted journey.
birth_registration.segment: Work on explanations, document preparation and a real counter visit. This is a simulated process, not legal guidance.
birth_registration.limit: Reaching the counter is not the same as a certificate being issued.
